# stacklet_iac_policy_collection (Resource)

Manages a Stacklet IaC policy collection, a set of IaC policies to evaluate. Deleting a policy collection also removes it from all projects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stacklet_iac_policy_collection" "example" {
  name       = "example"
  is_default = true
  policies = [
    "s3-bucket-encryption",
    "ec2-no-public-ip",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The unique name of the policy collection. It can't end with "-mirror", as that's reserved for collections mirroring policy sources.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the collection is a default, applied to projects that have no policy collections assigned.
- `policies` (Set of String) The names of policies in the collection.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stacklet_iac_policy_collection.example
  id = "$name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import stacklet_iac_policy_collection.example $name
```
